Abwicklung als DXF speichern (Biegelinie: Save the flat pattern as DXF (bend lines on layers of their own, up and down separately)
Rotation: zuerst ein Profil anklicken –: Revolve: click a profile first – or choose “Whole sketch”.
Gestrichelt in der Skizze: Biegelinien (: Dashed in the sketch: bend lines (start and end of every bend zone). In the DXF the outline is on layer 0, the bend zones on BIEGUNG, the centre line of every bend on BIEGUNG_AUF (red, up) or BIEGUNG_AB (blue, down), and its number, angle and radius on BIEGETEXT.
Der Abstand folgt der Maus: so weit sie: The distance follows the mouse: as far as it is away from the contour, on the side it is on. A click takes it over.
Versatz: mit der Maus den Abstand zeigen: Offset: show the distance with the mouse (preview) and click. Esc ends.
